Probe requalification hardening (25 Aug 2026)
---------------------------------------------
The current-stack client no longer owns/hard-codes HardWorld external-engine release
`NOSQL-ALGREL-EXTERNAL-0.13`. It requires a non-empty `NOSQL-ALGREL-EXTERNAL-*`
identity from the running stack and optionally checks an exact caller-supplied expected
identity for release certification.

Declared next external target: HardWorld v0.31-work + NoSQLServer v0.79 + msqlshim v0.21.
Those three executable archives were not mounted in this runtime when this probe update
was made, so no execution certification against that target is claimed here.
